description: aws_core CI/nightly boot-and-test profile (req-plugin-extdev-repo-ci; consumed by tap's plugin-ci.yml boot-and-test job and the nightly-plugins depth leg keyed on this file's existence). aws_core is fully self-contained — all 10 edge types reference only aws_core__ node types, the manifest declares no cross-plugin dependencies, and the sole Python dependency is boto3 — so this record installs aws_core ALONE, editable from _external/aws_core (the path plugin-ci.yml checks this repo out to inside the harness tree), so CI tests THIS repo's HEAD, not a released tag. Population is seed-only: it seeds the aws_core GRIFT (the aws dimension + region/AZ reference data) and boots to healthy. Collectors are NEVER fired — CI runs with an empty secrets root, and the boto3 collector plus the sacrificial-resource trial harness (tap_plugin/aws_core/tests/test_trial_run_live.py) are both gated off unless explicitly enabled (TAP_AWS_TRIAL_RUN=1), so there are no fire-collector steps and correspondingly no required_secrets (coherence rule: entries must be consumed by an enabled step).

plugins.note: Package-mode (tap_plugin.aws_core), installed EDITABLE from the CI checkout at _external/aws_core so the suite runs against this repo's HEAD. Tier-0 boto3 dep resolved at install. Self-contained: no sibling plugins are required to install, boot, or run its in-package tests.

steps.note: AWS dimension + region/AZ reference data (grift/dimension.grift.json + grift/regions.grift.json). Seed-only; the boto3 collector is not fired in CI.
